details: NewChirp 1.0.68 Windows read completed, then decode failed. Stock BaofengCommonHT.get_memory logs _mem.power (nonexistent) when lowpower is not 0/2 on tri-band radios, raising AttributeError. Affects 5RX, UV-S9X3, BF-A58S and any BaofengCommonHT radio with an out-of-range value; also unfixed upstream. Meaning of values 1/3 unknown (no image, CPS not obtainable from BTECH page without a browser).
summary: Read fails: No attribute power in struct memory
